name: Achillesmon
look: a lean warrior in black with golden armour, a tall white-and-purple plumed helmet, a long golden spear and round golden heel-shields flaring cyan wings of light
entry: A warrior who has never once been struck. It hurls its golden spear faster than sound, and the cyan wings on its heels carry it out of reach before anyone can strike back.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in mountains and hills.
